CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_HistorialTicket_ObtenerHistorial]
@Ticket_Id INT = 0
AS
BEGIN

	SELECT 
	hist.Id,
	hist.Ticket_Id,
	hist.EstatusTicket_Id,
	est.Nombre AS [Estatus],
	hist.Fecha,
	hist.Descripcion,
	hist.EsComentario,
	hist.Suscriptor_Id,
	hist.Usuario_Id,	
	CASE 
		WHEN usr.CorreoElectronico IS NULL THEN susc.CorreoElectronico
		ELSE usr.CorreoElectronico
	END AS [CorreoElectronico]
	FROM HistoricoTicket hist
	LEFT JOIN EstatusTicket est ON hist.EstatusTicket_Id = est.Id
	LEFT JOIN Usuario usr ON hist.Usuario_Id = usr.Id
	LEFT JOIN Suscriptor susc ON hist.Suscriptor_Id = susc.Id
	WHERE hist.Ticket_Id = @Ticket_Id
	ORDER BY hist.Id DESC

END
Name: rpt_HistorialTicket_ObtenerHistorial
